item.name: mesh-gradient
item.summary: background: multi-color organic mesh gradient via WebGL2 (webgl2, client-only, reduced motion -> static poster, DPR <= 1.5 on mobile/Tier 2)

useWhen: Hero sections requiring rich, fluid multi-color ambient backgrounds
Telemetry or premium landing surfaces needing organic color transitions
Sections requiring soft chromatic fields with zero server hydration shift
avoidWhen: Dense text sections where text contrast over the gradient has not been verified
Surfaces already running another full-screen WebGL shader in the same viewport
Devices with battery-saver or forced reduced motion enabled

alternatives.name: noise-field
alternatives.when: When monochromatic procedural simplex flow lines are desired

alternatives.name: particle-field
alternatives.when: When discrete kinematic points and pointer repulsion are preferred

tiers.0: CSS multi-radial gradient poster only, no WebGL (server render, prefers-reduced-motion, Save-Data, no WebGL2, or frame-guard downgrade)
tiers.1: CSS multi-radial gradient poster only (coarse pointer with low-end hints: deviceMemory <= 2 or <= 4 cores)
tiers.2: WebGL2 at DPR <= 1.5, 0.75 render scale, 2 octaves (coarse pointer without low-end hints, or fine pointer with low-end hints or viewport < 480px)
tiers.3: WebGL2 at DPR <= 2.0, full render scale, 4 octaves (fine pointer with hover, no low-end hints)

reducedMotion.description: Renders the static CSS gradient poster with no WebGL context and no animation frames (Decision 14 D-A). Under prefers-reduced-motion the runtime tier is 0, so WebGL does not start.

input.touch: None; no touch or pointer listeners. Coarse pointers with low-end hints get the tier 1 poster; other coarse-pointer devices run WebGL at tier 2.
input.keyboard: None; the component has no interactive elements. Poster, scrim and canvas layers are aria-hidden; children keep their own semantics.

a11y.notes: The poster, scrim and canvas layers are aria-hidden; the root element and children are not. There is no built-in pause button: pause with the paused prop or the runtime pauseAll()/resumeAll(). The optional scrim lowers background luminance behind children but contrast is not computed; verify text contrast for your colours.

props.name: colors
props.effect: CSS colours resolved from host tokens. Only the first four are used (extra entries are ignored); missing entries reuse earlier ones. The first colour is the background.

props.name: swirl
props.effect: Vortex swirl strength in the gradient field.

props.name: grainOverlay
props.effect: Post-processing fine film grain overlay intensity.

props.name: scrim
props.effect: Renders a radial scrim of the first colour (20% centre to 80% edge opacity) over the canvas to lower background luminance behind children. Does not guarantee text contrast; verify for your colours.

props.name: paused
props.effect: Freezes this instance's shader animation loop. The global pauseAll() also stops it.

props.name: maxTier
props.effect: Upper bound on the capability tier (0 to 3); the tier is the minimum of this and the runtime tier.

props.name: reducedMotion
props.effect: Optional. No default (follows prefers-reduced-motion). true forces the static poster. false only skips the prop-level check: under prefers-reduced-motion the runtime tier is still 0, so WebGL still does not start. Leave unset.

props.name: className
props.effect: Extra classes on the root div (the built-in class fb-mesh-gradient is kept).

props.name: style
props.effect: Optional. No default. Inline styles on the root div, merged after the built-in layout and background colour (consumer wins).

props.name: ref
props.effect: Receives the root <div> that holds the poster and the canvas.

props.name: children
props.effect: Optional. No default. Content layered above the poster, canvas and scrim.

mistakes: Do not combine multiple MeshGradient instances in the same viewport.

scrim defaults to false. Turn it on behind text, but it only lowers background luminance and does not guarantee 4.5:1 contrast: verify contrast for your colours and use host foreground tokens for text.
Do not set reducedMotion={false} to try to force WebGL; it does not override the user's preference (the runtime tier stays 0 under prefers-reduced-motion).
Never call requestAnimationFrame directly to animate the mesh.
verify: Confirm the static CSS multi-radial gradient poster renders in server HTML (CLS <= 0.01).
Confirm that when prefers-reduced-motion is active, the static poster renders with zero WebGL contexts allocated and zero rAF cycles.
Confirm context lease is released when scrolled out of view.

notices: Includes 2D Simplex Noise from stegu/webgl-noise (MIT Copyright 2011 Ashima Arts, Stefan Gustavson).
